en: Add a new customer with no internet, and sell to them straight away
New customers are sent by themselves when the internet is back
The app warns you before you sign out with sales that are not sent yet
sw: Ongeza mteja mpya bila intaneti, na umuuzie papo hapo
Wateja wapya hutumwa wenyewe intaneti ikirudi
Programu inakuonya kabla ya kutoka ukiwa na mauzo ambayo hayajatumwa
